selected_headlines: Boil water notice extended 24 hours for 21,000 customers in western Port St. Lucie
source_headlines: Boil water notice continues for 21,000 customers west of I-95 in Port St. Lucie - WPEC
novel_facts: The advisory has been extended 24 hours while water-quality testing is completed.
Officials warn that testing could keep the advisory in place beyond the initial 48-hour timeframe.
